# Keep the GPU machine's own torch stack (2.5.1+cu121 / torchvision 0.20.1): pip would otherwise install a
# newer torch into the environment, which then clashes with the machine's torchvision.
# transformers 5.x refuses torch < 2.6 at runtime, so stay on 4.x.  Not used for Moirai (own full environment).
torch==2.5.1
torchvision==0.20.1
transformers<5
